dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is something troubling you?

dialogues.speaker: Michelle
dialogues.text: Yes, actually, but it isn't a serious matter... Well, do you know about Philanemo Mushrooms?

dialogues.speaker: Michelle
dialogues.text: These mushrooms just spring up all over the windmill when we're not looking. I've cleaned a portion of it, but there are just too many.

dialogues.speaker: Michelle
dialogues.text: I'm racking my brains as to how to go about cleaning at the moment. If you could take a few with you, that would be great.

dialogues.speaker: Michelle
dialogues.text: Even Barbatos needs his rest...

dialogues.speaker: Michelle
dialogues.text: Rest is only rest after a day of hard work, otherwise, it's just loafing off.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me about the windmills.

dialogues.speaker: Michelle
dialogues.text: The windmills are instrumental in drawing water for Mondstadt.

dialogues.speaker: Michelle
dialogues.text: Our family has worked with windmills for generations. This is why I'm well aware of it.

dialogues.speaker: Michelle
dialogues.text: Tired of it? Not at all. I'm always full of energy as long as the wind of Barbatos blows.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me about Barbatos.

dialogues.speaker: Michelle
dialogues.text: Barbatos is a benevolent and hard-working archon.

dialogues.speaker: Michelle
dialogues.text: I'm sure the wind, or Barbatos, would listen to all of your troubles.

dialogues.speaker: Michelle
dialogues.text: However, rely on yourself, not Barbatos, on your own tasks.

dialogues.speaker: Michelle
dialogues.text: Only you can solve your own troubles, right?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are you doing?

dialogues.speaker: Michelle
dialogues.text: Hush... I'm receiving the will of Barbatos.

dialogues.speaker: Michelle
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Michelle
dialogues.text: Be respectful toward the windmills. Barbatos' wind is all around us.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Stormterror...

dialogues.speaker: Michelle
dialogues.text: Never mind my safety. I just hope that this windmill that my family has protected for generation upon generation will be fine.

dialogues.speaker: Michelle
dialogues.text: *sigh* The storm created when the dragon attacked previously was far too strong. I wonder if the windmill has taken damage.

dialogues.speaker: Michelle
dialogues.text: I wanted to climb it to have a look, but the Knights stopped me.

dialogues.speaker: Michelle
dialogues.text: They said that it was too dangerous because Stormterror could attack again at any moment...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Stormterror...

dialogues.speaker: Michelle
dialogues.text: Seeing the windmill safe puts my heart at ease.

dialogues.speaker: Michelle
dialogues.text: The sound of the windmill spinning in the storm was frightening — it was as if the wind itself was crying out.

dialogues.speaker: Michelle
dialogues.text: How wonderful! Thanks to Lord Barbatos' protection, the windmill has returned to normal.
